races.paceDynamic: Installment and Butterfly Mountain will contest the early lead, with both showing confirmed front-running tendencies over this distance. Their sustained battle through the opening mile will create an honest, searching gallop that should stretch the field. The good to soft ground won't dramatically slow the pace, allowing the leaders to maintain a strong rhythm throughout. This sustained tempo strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish with one run, particularly those with proven stamina like Poet's Duke and Try Them.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Installment and Butterfly Mountain maintain their duel through halfway
scenarios.body: The honest pace stretches the field and sets up perfectly for strong finishers coming from off the pace. Hold-up horses with stamina reserves can time one decisive run in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leaders Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If the front two go too hard early and fade dramatically
scenarios.body: The pace-setters burn out after setting unsustainable fractions, allowing prominent racers to inherit the lead. Those sitting just behind the leaders can capitalize without expending energy in the early battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one leader gets first run on the other at the second-last
scenarios.body: The winner breaks clear from the early pace battle and holds on grimly despite the sustained effort. Superior fitness or class allows them to repel late challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble Finish
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders stop quickly and no horse takes charge
scenarios.body: The lack of sustained pace creates a bunched field where any horse can win from any position. The race becomes a lottery decided by jumping and positioning at the final hurdle.

watchPoints.text: Installment and Butterfly Mountain must be watched early - if either gets an uncontested lead the race dynamics change completely
Try Them and Poet's Duke are the key hold-up horses to follow - their positioning at halfway will indicate if the pace scenario is unfolding
Fabhcun represents the Elliott stable and bears watching if positioned prominently but not committed early
Several runners including Bravemans Bounce and Secret Order have fade tendencies that make them vulnerable if the pace is strong
The ground conditions favor horses with proven form on good to soft, particularly Try Them and Cornaroya Rocco

races.paceDynamic: Shinnhill is the only confirmed front-runner and will set a comfortable tempo without early pressure. The danger comes from mid-race congestion as seven prominent runners (Long Gone, Kasper Hauser, Must Meet Cecil, Malbay Madness, Premier Rogue, Bhean Saibhre, Mister Vic) fight for the same tactical position 2-3 furlongs out. Hold-up horses like Dairy Force, Metamorpheus, and Dontgowithjoe can sit quietly behind this scramble and attack late. This pace dynamic strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the mid-race traffic and finish powerfully.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners clash and create excessive pace pressure 2-3 out
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets the perfect setup as Shinnhill softens up front and the prominent pack burns energy fighting each other. Late runners sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners (Malbay Madness or Bhean Saibhre) gets first run on the field
scenarios.body: They escape the congestion before it develops and get a clear run at a tiring Shinnhill. The hold-up horses have too much ground to make up from their patient position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Shinnhill Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and Shinnhill gets soft fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The front-runner proves too strong when the field closes, having conserved energy in a tactical affair. The prominent runners can't match his finishing kick after a patient ride.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If everyone sits too quiet behind Shinnhill and it becomes a mad dash
scenarios.body: The race turns into a sprint from 2f out where the best turn of foot wins regardless of position. This chaos scenario can throw up any winner with tactical luck.

watchPoints.text: Traffic chaos developing 2-3 furlongs out as seven prominent runners (Long Gone, Kasper Hauser, Must Meet Cecil, Malbay Madness, Premier Rogue, Bhean Saibhre, Mister Vic) converge on same position
Shinnhill's stamina reserves after comfortable early lead - TS rating of 27 suggests vulnerability in final furlong

Amateur and conditional jockeys (Calum Hogan, Carl Millar, Eoghan Finegan, Harry Sexton, Michael Kenneally, Peter Smithers, Shane O'Callaghan, Josh Williamson, Mr O McGill) making crucial tactical decisions in heavy traffic
Dairy Force and Metamorpheus positioned perfectly behind the developing pace battle to strike late
Long absence runners Shinnhill (117d), Centreofattention (160d), Bhean Saibhre (263d), Dontgowithjoe (261d), Mister Vic (283d) showing fitness on return

races.paceDynamic: Ottoman Style will lead from the front with minimal pressure early, as most of this field prefer to be held up or track leaders rather than make the running. Ceanndana and Faceman may track the leader prominently, but neither will pressure him through the middle stages. This sets up a genuine staying test where the pace will be steady early before quickening from the second-last hurdle. The tactical verdict strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as Ottoman Style's soft lead will leave plenty in the tank for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ottoman Style sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays modest until the closing stages
scenarios.body: The steady gallop allows patient riders to conserve energy before unleashing finishing kicks. Mordor, Digby and Ad Caelum all excel when able to come from off the pace in truly-run races.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent trackers strike
scenarios.trigger: If Ceanndana and Faceman apply sustained pressure to Ottoman Style from halfway
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and prevents hold-up horses from closing effectively. Those positioned prominently throughout can kick clear when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Ottoman Style wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains his advantage and sees out the trip strongly despite carrying top weight
scenarios.body: His uncontested lead proves decisive as the handicapper's assessment proves accurate. The 10-year-old's stamina reserves overcome the 160lbs burden in the testing ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If no horse applies any pressure to Ottoman Style and the race becomes a sprint from the last
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace means superior class rather than tactical positioning determines the outcome. The highest-rated horses prevail regardless of running style.

watchPoints.text: Ottoman Style could steal this if allowed to dictate his own fractions without any sustained pressure from the field
Mordor's fitness after 427 days off the track, though Elliott's 46 runs in France suggest careful preparation
The weight differential between Zam Bobbler (149lbs) and the top-weighted horses could prove decisive over this trip
Several hold-up horses including Digby, Ad Caelum and Mystic Malina will need clear runs in the closing stages
Ceanndana's lengthy absence of 195 days makes his fitness a question mark despite strong previous course form

races.paceDynamic: Phoenix Arizona is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings without early pressure, likely setting a steady gallop through the first circuit. Following Orders, Kate Knows Best, Strange Currency, Drop A Threat, Jerisk Star and Warriors Wood will track prominently but none are aggressive pace-forcers. The large field of hold-up horses including In The Trenches, Shellrunforbriggs, Better Times and Rockstown Girl will rely on finding gaps in the straight. This sustainable early pace followed by a cavalry charge finish strongly favours front-runners who can kick clear and prominent racers who can respond to Phoenix Arizona's move.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If Phoenix Arizona maintains his lead turning for home and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The lone leader gets first run on the field and stretches away as the hold-up brigade struggle for racing room behind. His tactical advantage proves decisive in a large field where traffic problems are inevitable.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners gets into Phoenix Arizona's slipstream and outkicks him
scenarios.body: Following Orders or Warriors Wood travel smoothly behind the leader and have enough pace to collar him in the final furlong. The hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the change of pace up front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and Phoenix Arizona stops to a walk
scenarios.body: The strong finishers get a perfect setup as Phoenix Arizona fades badly, allowing In The Trenches or Shellrunforbriggs to unleash their finishing kicks. Traffic problems still hamper several runners despite the slow pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos And Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or a pile-up creates complete disruption
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with several runners brought down or hampered, allowing an unconsidered runner to emerge from the pack. Form and tactics become irrelevant in a survival contest.

watchPoints.text: Phoenix Arizona could steal this race if he gets an uncontested lead as no other horse wants to make the running
Following Orders and Warriors Wood are the main threats to the leader from prominent positions but need to time their challenges perfectly
The large field of hold-up horses including In The Trenches and Shellrunforbriggs will struggle if the pace doesn't collapse
Kate Knows Best could disrupt the pace scenario if she decides to challenge Phoenix Arizona for the early lead
Several runners carry headgear changes including Gunnery Sergeant and Drop A Threat suggesting connections are concerned about their attitudes

races.paceDynamic: Marv Michael emerges as the lone natural front runner and will dictate terms from the flag, setting a sustainable gallop without pressure in the early stages. Milan Forth, Lisleigh Lad, Park That, Champagne Mahler and Nas Na Riogh will track him in prominent positions, creating a decent-sized leading group. The large field of 17 runners means the pace will naturally quicken from 3 out as the prominent horses fan out and the hold-up brigade launch their challenges. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can position close enough to avoid traffic problems but have the tactical speed to respond when Marv Michael kicks clear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Marv Michael Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Marv Michael gets an uncontested lead and builds a winning margin approaching the last
scenarios.body: His 230-day break becomes irrelevant as he controls the tempo throughout, with the chasing pack unable to peg back his advantage up the hill. The front runner's class tells when it matters most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Milan Forth or Lisleigh Lad challenge Marv Michael approaching two out
scenarios.body: The pace quickens significantly as the prominent runners engage in a tactical battle, allowing the best stayer among them to prevail in a driving finish. Milan Forth's recent form edge proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Sweeps Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too strong and the prominent horses tie up
scenarios.body: Cave Court or Littlefoot times their run perfectly from the back, finding gaps as the leaders weaken and storming home to catch them close to the line. The 2m4½f trip plays into their hands.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Park That Strikes Gold
scenarios.trigger: If the Eddie Bolger-trained runner gets a perfect position in third or fourth throughout
scenarios.body: Park That's low weight and Mark Walsh's tactical nous combine perfectly as he slips through on the rail to steal the race from the tiring leaders. His recent Fairyhouse second suggests he's primed.

watchPoints.text: Marv Michael could prove unbeatable if allowed uncontested lead given his superior class ratings
Traffic problems likely in home straight with 17 runners and many hold-up horses needing room
Milan Forth's 7lb weight allowance makes him effective top weight in what looks competitive handicap
Ground conditions may deteriorate further given consistent good to yielding reports throughout card
Park That represents value angle with Mark Walsh taking ride for in-form Eddie Bolger stable
